display.purpose: Hero balance total. One value per screen.

title.purpose: Card headers, sheet titles, modal headings.

body.purpose: Transaction descriptions, merchant names, contextual prose.

label.purpose: Section eyebrows — uppercase tracked. One per card maximum.

numeric.purpose: All currency values in Geist Mono. Never humanist-sans for numbers.

shadows.name: ambient-surface
shadows.purpose: White cards on the sage background. Barely perceptible; separating, not lifting.

shadows.name: hero-depth
shadows.purpose: The hero balance card only. One per screen; its rarity is the point.

shadows.name: sheet-lift
shadows.purpose: Smart Entry bottom sheet. Directional — implies the sheet emerges from below.

shadows.name: segment-lift
shadows.purpose: Active segment in mode toggle controls.

motion.name: spring-content

breakpoints.name: mobile-first

narrative.overview:
LedgeIt's visual system is built around a single idea: a well-kept personal record that a family trusts. Not a bank product, not an enterprise dashboard — a personal artifact that feels like it belongs in your home. The design earns that trust through composure. Deep Forest Green grounds every screen; generous whitespace creates breathing room in what could otherwise be a stressful context; spring-driven animations communicate responsiveness without urgency.

The system is soft-premium: rounded forms, layered tonal surfaces, and ambient shadows that separate layers without drama. Nothing is decorative. Every radius, every shadow, every animation serves either comprehension or confidence. When something moves, it's because a state changed and the user needs to perceive that change — not because motion is present by default.

This system explicitly rejects: the navy-and-gold of traditional finance apps, the neon glow and volatile energy of crypto products, and the information-wall approach of tools like Mint where the first screen is a 10-chart dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Deep Forest Green as the anchor: earns authority without coldness
Tonal surface hierarchy instead of hard borders: five steps from bg to surface-highest
Spring physics throughout: responsive, not mechanical
Monospaced numerics: Geist Mono for all currency values — precision reads as trustworthy
Soft-premium radius vocabulary: hero at 24px, cards at 16px, icons at 12px, chips as pills

rules.name: The One-Hue Rule
rules.body: Every color in this system, from the deepest accent to the palest background, originates from the same green-teal hue family. Importing a warm neutral or a blue-gray breaks the palette's coherence.

rules.name: The Semantic Delta Rule
rules.body: Gain Emerald and Danger Crimson are financial signal colors. They must never be repurposed for decorative or non-financial UI.

rules.name: The Mono Lock Rule
rules.body: Currency values always render in Geist Mono with tabular-nums. A humanist-sans amount in a feed row breaks the visual language that separates data from description.

rules.name: The Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: All shadows use rgba(0,53,46,...) as the shadow color. Never rgba(0,0,0,...) or any neutral gray.

rules.name: The One Hero Rule
rules.body: Only one element per screen earns the Hero Depth shadow. Adding Hero Depth to any other element dilutes the hierarchy.

dos: Do use green-tinted shadows (rgba(0,53,46,...)) for all box-shadows. Never neutral gray.
Do render all currency values in Geist Mono with tabular-nums and font-bold.
Do animate with spring physics. Easing curves for simple opacity fades; spring for spatial movement.
Do use the tonal surface ramp to convey depth before reaching for shadows.
Do keep the hero balance card as the sole bearer of the Hero Depth shadow.
Do use backdrop-filter: blur on the Smart Entry sheet as a purposeful overlay metaphor.
Do assign category colors semantically. These are a fixed vocabulary; don't reassign them.
Do support prefers-reduced-motion on all Framer Motion animations.
donts: Don't use navy, gold, or any warm-neutral (sand, cream, linen) backgrounds.
Don't use neon accents, glowing shadows, or dark-mode electric color.
Don't build screens with more than one chart type visible simultaneously.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards.
Don't apply background-clip: text with a gradient for decorative headings.
Don't use glassmorphism on cards or panels other than the Smart Entry sheet.
Don't repeat the Label eyebrow pattern more than once per card.
Don't use the Hero Depth shadow on anything other than the balance hero card.
Don't render amounts or balances in Plus Jakarta Sans. Geist Mono is the precision signal.
Don't animate layout properties. Animate transform and opacity only.
